grammarTopic: Câu gián tiếp + suggest / had better
speakingTopic: Học tập & kế hoạch tương lai

plan.content: Câu gián tiếp, suggest / had better / advise, cấu tạo từ, cách soát lỗi sai
10 câu + 5 câu viết lại (lấy từ 20 mẫu trong tài liệu trường)
Tab Luyện thêm: 9 câu điền + 10 câu Tìm lỗi sai trong 15 phút, rồi 5 câu viết lại
Tab Đọc: Origin of Jeans (10 phút). Tab Luyện thêm: Jeff Stringer (8 phút). Đọc câu hỏi trước, gạch từ khóa
Xem câu chứa đáp án, học từ mới
20 họ từ + 10 câu cấu tạo từ
Gõ “thi nói” trong cuộc trò chuyện: giới thiệu 4–5 câu + chủ đề Học tập

sections.title: Câu gián tiếp: 4 loại câu
rows: said (that) + lùi thì. said to sb → told sb.
She asked Tom if / whether he was hungry.
asked + if/whether + S + V. KHÔNG đảo.
He asked me where I lived.
asked + wh- + S + V. Bỏ do/does/did, KHÔNG đảo.
He told me not to be late.
told / asked / warned + sb + (not) to V.

sections.title: Lùi thì và đổi từ chỉ thời gian
rows: am / is / are · V(s) · will · can
the next day (the following day) · the day before · the following week

sections.title: Gợi ý và khuyên
rows: "Why don't you apply for the job, Ann?" said Sue.
Sue suggested that Ann (should) apply for the job.
suggest + that + S + (should) + V nguyên mẫu, hoặc suggest + V-ing. KHÔNG có suggest sb to V.
Why don't we stay in this evening?
Let's + V = Why don't we + V?
had better + V nguyên mẫu; phủ định: had better not + V.
If I were you, I would rest.

sections.title: Cấu tạo từ: nhìn vị trí chỗ trống
rows: Sau a / the / my / his, hoặc làm chủ ngữ
make a big difference · his success
Trước danh từ; sau be / become / feel / seem
an energetic person · It becomes flexible.
Bổ nghĩa cho động từ hoặc tính từ
Tiền tố un-, im-, in-, dis-, ir-
-ed: người cảm thấy · -ing: vật gây ra cảm giác
I'm bored. · The film is boring.

sections.title: Tìm lỗi sai: soát 6 chỗ theo thứ tự
headers: Lỗi hay gặp trong đề trường
rows: warned that a storm approached (đang tới)
becomes extremely flexibly · as frequent as possible
every fruits · the number of homework
a MP · only part of information
which (có dấu phẩy → không dùng that)

notes: Câu hỏi gián tiếp là câu kể: không có dấu hỏi, không đảo trợ động từ.
Động từ tường thuật ở hiện tại (says, asks) thì KHÔNG lùi thì.
said + (to sb) + that…; told + sb + that… Không nói said me, không nói told that.
Phần Tìm lỗi sai: mỗi câu chỉ có 1 lỗi. Đọc cả câu, rồi soát 4 chỗ gạch chân theo 6 bước trên. Không chắc thì chọn chỗ có vấn đề về loại từ hoặc liên từ trước.

traps.title: Đảo trợ động từ trong câu hỏi gián tiếp
traps.wrong: He asked me where did I live.
traps.right: He asked me where I lived.
traps.why: Gián tiếp là câu kể: S + V, bỏ did, lùi thì live → lived.

traps.title: suggest sb to V
traps.wrong: He suggested me to go home.
traps.right: He suggested that I (should) go home. / He suggested going home.
traps.why: suggest không đi với sb + to V. (advise / tell / ask thì đi được: advised me to go.)

traps.title: said me
traps.wrong: She said me that she was busy.
traps.right: She told me that she was busy. / She said to me that…

grammarMcq.explain: Câu hỏi gián tiếp: wh- + S + V, không đảo, lùi thì → the film started.

grammarMcq.q: Tom asked me ___ I could help him with his homework.
grammarMcq.explain: Câu hỏi Yes/No (Can you help me?) → asked + if/whether.

grammarMcq.q: She suggested ___ to the beach at the weekend.
grammarMcq.explain: suggest + V-ing (hoặc suggest that + S + should + V).

grammarMcq.q: You'd better ___ an umbrella. It's going to rain.
grammarMcq.explain: had better + V nguyên mẫu, không có to.

grammarMcq.q: He told me ___ late for the meeting again.
grammarMcq.explain: Mệnh lệnh phủ định gián tiếp: told sb not to V.

grammarMcq.q: She said that she ___ me the next day.
grammarMcq.explain: "I will call you tomorrow" → lùi thì will → would; tomorrow → the next day.

grammarMcq.q: My mother asked me whether I ___ my homework.
grammarMcq.explain: Trực tiếp: "Have you finished…?" → lùi thì have finished → had finished.

grammarMcq.q: The children were very ___ when they heard the news about the trip.
grammarMcq.explain: Người cảm thấy → -ed: excited. exciting dùng cho vật gây hứng thú.

grammarMcq.q: He drives very ___, so he has never had an accident.
grammarMcq.explain: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ drives → trạng từ carefully.

transform.source: "Why don't you apply for the job, Ann?" said Sue.
answers: Sue suggested that Ann should apply for the job.
Sue suggested that Ann apply for the job.
Sue suggested Ann should apply for the job.
Sue suggested Ann apply for the job.
Sue suggested that Ann applied for the job.
transform.explain: Why don't you + V? → suggested that + S + (should) + V. Không viết suggested Ann to apply.

answers: She asked Tom if he was hungry.
She asked Tom whether he was hungry.
transform.explain: Hỏi Yes/No → asked + người + if/whether + S + V lùi thì (are → was, you → he).

transform.source: "Where did you buy your shoes, Sally?" asked Gail.
answers: Gail asked Sally where she had bought her shoes.
Gail asked Sally where she bought her shoes.
transform.explain: Hỏi Wh-: where + S + V, bỏ did, lùi thì bought → had bought, your → her.

transform.source: The teacher said to his student, "Don't be late tomorrow."
answers: The teacher told his student not to be late the next day.
The teacher told his student not to be late the following day.
transform.explain: Mệnh lệnh phủ định → told sb not to V; tomorrow → the next day.

transform.source: I advise you to go now or you'll be late.
answers: You'd better go now or you'll be late.
You'd better go now or you will be late.
You'd better go now, or you'll be late.
transform.explain: advise sb to V ⇔ You'd better + V nguyên mẫu.

extra.title: Đề trường · Practice Test 1
extra.note: Câu hỏi lấy nguyên từ tài liệu ôn của trường. Làm 2 phần đầu trong 15 phút (đề thật: Paper 2 có 30 phút cho 35 câu), bài đọc 8 phút. Tìm lỗi sai: phần gạch chân được đánh dấu [ ](A)…(D), chọn chỗ PHẢI SỬA.

sets.title: Sentence completion (36–45)
sets.directions: Choose the word or phrase which best completes each sentence.

items.q: I live in Nha Trang, ___ is one of the most beautiful cities of Vietnam.
items.explain: Có dấu phẩy và ngay sau là động từ (is) → which. where cần S + V phía sau. Đây đúng là lỗi where/which của bạn.

items.q: Daniel won't be able to understand the speakers ___ there's an interpreter.
items.explain: unless = nếu không: sẽ không hiểu NẾU KHÔNG có phiên dịch.

items.q: Trung drank only ___ water because he didn't play any sports.
items.explain: water không đếm được → little / a little. only a little = chỉ một ít. few / a few dùng cho danh từ đếm được.

items.q: What are you complaining about? It's so easy that ___ a baby can do it.
items.explain: even + danh từ = ngay cả. even if / even though cần mệnh đề.

items.q: The manager, ___ his factory's products were poor in quality, decided to give his workers further training.
items.explain: who knew → knowing (rút gọn chủ động dùng V-ing).

items.q: I know he doesn't want to go to the meeting – but he shall go, ___ he likes it or not.
items.explain: whether … or not = dù có … hay không.

items.q: "Can you wait while I run into the library?" – "OK, ___ you hurry."
items.explain: as long as = miễn là. Ngày 3 bạn chọn nhầm unless ở dạng này.

items.q: I'm much fitter now ___ all the exercise I take.
items.explain: Sau là cụm danh từ (all the exercise) → because of.

items.q: The man ___ by the dustbin stopped us and asked us for some money.
items.explain: who was standing → standing. Câu đã có động từ chính (stopped) nên không thêm was standing.

sets.title: Error identification (46–55)
sets.directions: Each sentence has four underlined parts marked A, B, C or D. Identify the ONE that should be corrected.

items.q: [When](A) she heard the loud [crash](B), Marge ran [outside](C) in the snow [despite](D) she wasn't wearing any shoes.
items.explain: Sau despite phải là danh từ / V-ing. Sau đây là mệnh đề (she wasn't wearing) → although.

items.q: Almost [every](A) fruits and vegetables contain riboflavin; the [richest](B) sources are [leafy](C) green vegetables [such as](D) spinach, kale, or turnip greens.
items.explain: every + danh từ SỐ ÍT. fruits and vegetables số nhiều → all.

items.q: Although he tried his [best](A) to be [the winner](B), [but](C) he failed [to win](D) the race.
items.explain: Although … but: chỉ dùng một trong hai → bỏ but.

items.q: [Some](A) parents have expressed [concern](B) about the [number](C) of [homework](D) their children have to do.
items.explain: homework không đếm được → the amount of. the number of + danh từ đếm được số nhiều.

items.q: The [only](A) good way to get achievement in [learning](B) English is [to practise](C) it as [frequent](D) as possible.
items.explain: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ practise → trạng từ: as frequently as possible.

items.q: I [was just about](A) to enter the station [then](B) someone grabbed me [by the shoulders](C) and threw me [to the ground](D).
items.explain: be about to V … when … = sắp làm gì thì… → when.

items.q: James has [always](A) wanted to go [into](B) politics and he has [just](C) been elected as [a MP](D).
items.explain: MP đọc /em piː/, bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm → an MP.

items.q: I [haven't used](A) the computer [since](B) last week, [therefore](C) I don't know [what's](D) wrong with it.
items.explain: therefore không nối 2 mệnh đề sau dấu phẩy → so (hoặc tách câu: . Therefore, …).

items.q: Children's games, which are amusements [involve](A) more than one individual, [appear to](B) be [culturally](C) [universal](D).
items.explain: amusements involving / that involve more than one individual. Đã có động từ chính appear nên involve phải đổi.

items.q: Ginger capsules, [that are](A) sold in [most](B) health-food stores, [have been](C) found [effective as](D) a remedy.
items.explain: Có dấu phẩy → không dùng that → which are.

sets.title: Bài đọc · Jeff Stringer – Judge (30–35)
sets.directions: Read the passage and choose the best answer. Giới hạn 8 phút.
passage: I've always enjoyed being with other people and I suppose I've always had a strong opinion about what is wrong and what is right, even from when I was a young child. That used to irritate my brothers and sisters because I would grass on them if they did something wrong. They had secrets that they wouldn't share with me and I probably missed out on a lot, because of that. Not that I blame them.

I actually studied history at university and then, in my final year, I had a work placement in a lawyer's office. I was fascinated from day one and as soon as I graduated I applied to do a degree in law.

I get a real buzz from fighting for justice, no matter what kind of case it is. It can be hard not to get emotionally involved at times. You have to follow your head and not your heart in such situations.
I make it a personal rule not to take my work home with me. Once I leave the court, I switch off and concentrate on my family. They will always be my number one priority.

items.q: Which of the following best describes the writer?
options: A workaholic who puts work before family.
A man who cares about his family and his clients.
items.explain: Đoạn 3: đấu tranh cho công lý, dễ xúc động vì thân chủ. Đoạn 4: gia đình là ưu tiên số 1. B ngược lại (không mang việc về nhà).

items.q: Why did the writer's brothers and sisters get annoyed with him?
options: Because he was their parents' favourite child.
Because he followed them all the time.
Because he got them into trouble.
items.explain: grass on sb = mách lẻo, tố cáo → làm anh chị em bị phạt (got them into trouble).

items.q: What does he say about his job?
options: He has a lot of job satisfaction.
He often gets emotionally involved with his clients.
He wins a lot of cases.
items.explain: get a real buzz from = rất hứng thú, thỏa mãn với công việc. B sai: 'at times' (thỉnh thoảng), không phải 'often'.

items.q: 'such situations' (paragraph 3) refers to ___.
options: when he gets a real buzz from his job
when he follows his head and not his heart
items.explain: Đọc câu ngay trước: It can be hard not to get emotionally involved at times → such situations = lúc bị cuốn theo cảm xúc.

items.q: What does the writer do at the end of the working day?
options: Finish off any work that he has at home.
Leave all his work problems at the court.
Tell his family all about his working day.
items.explain: not to take my work home … Once I leave the court, I switch off = để hết công việc lại ở tòa.

items.q: Which of the following is the best description of how the writer feels about life?
items.explain: Thích công việc (real buzz), gia đình là ưu tiên → tích cực, hài lòng. Không có từ nào nói căng thẳng hay chán.

transform.source: Although the weather was good, we stayed indoors.
answers: Despite the good weather, we stayed indoors.
Despite the weather being good, we stayed indoors.
Despite the fact that the weather was good, we stayed indoors.
transform.explain: Although + mệnh đề → Despite + cụm danh từ (the good weather).

transform.source: In spite of having an English name, he is in fact German.
answers: Although he has an English name, he is in fact German.
Although he has an English name, he is German.
transform.explain: In spite of + V-ing → Although + S + V (thêm chủ ngữ he, chia has).

transform.source: I am not as good at football as he is.
answers: He is better at football than I am.
He is better at football than me.
He is better than me at football.
He is better than I am at football.
transform.explain: not as good as → đổi chủ ngữ, dùng so sánh hơn: better than.

transform.source: He isn't old enough to vote.
answers: He is too young to vote.
transform.explain: not old enough ↔ too young (tính từ trái nghĩa).

transform.source: It is impossible to learn a foreign language in a week.
answers: Learning a foreign language in a week is impossible.
transform.explain: It is + adj + to V ⇔ V-ing + … + is + adj.

reading.title: The Origin of Jeans (Test 1 · 11–17)
paragraphs: In 1853, the California gold rush was in full swing and everyday items were in short supply. Levi Strauss, a 24-year-old German immigrant, left New York for San Francisco with a small supply of dry goods with the intention of opening a branch of his brother's New York dry goods business. Shortly after his arrival, a prospector wanted to know what Mr. Strauss was selling. When Strauss told him he had rough canvas cloth used for tents and wagon covers, the prospector said, 'You should have brought trousers!', because he couldn't find a pair of trousers strong enough to last.

Levi Strauss had the canvas made into work trousers. Miners liked the trousers, but complained that the fabric was not very comfortable and tended to chafe. Levi Strauss substituted the canvas with a twilled cotton cloth from France called 'serge de Nimes.' The fabric later became known as denim and the trousers were nicknamed blue jeans. Then Levi Strauss and Nevada tailor David Jacobs co-patented the process of putting small metal rivets in places such as the sides of the pockets that needed extra strength. On May 20, 1873, they received U.S. Patent No. 139,121. This date is now considered the official birthday of 'blue jeans.'

But why were they called blue jeans? Denim is unique in its singular connection with one colour. It is made from thread that is traditionally dyed with blue pigment obtained from indigo dye. Indigo was linked with practical fabrics and work clothing. The durability of indigo as a colour and its darkness of tone made it a good choice when frequent washing was not possible.

questions.q: What is the purpose of this text?
questions.explain: Bài kể lịch sử ra đời của quần jeans, không bán hàng, không tranh luận → cung cấp thông tin.
questions.evidence: But why were they called blue jeans?

options: He was selling textile and clothing.
He was selling tools for gold mining.
questions.explain: dry goods = vải vóc, quần áo; ông định mở chi nhánh cửa hàng dry goods. Prospector (người đi tìm vàng) là người khác trong bài.
questions.evidence: with a small supply of dry goods with the intention of opening a branch of his brother's New York dry goods business

questions.q: The expression 'in full swing' in line 1 most probably means ___.
questions.explain: in full swing = đang lúc sôi động nhất. Đoán từ ngữ cảnh: cơn sốt vàng → mọi thứ khan hiếm vì quá nhiều người đổ về.
questions.evidence: the California gold rush was in full swing

questions.q: 'in short supply' (line 1) means nearly the same as ___.
options: going on for a short time
supplied in a very short time
questions.explain: in short supply = khan hiếm, thiếu. Bẫy A, C: thấy chữ short nên đoán là 'ngắn'.
questions.evidence: everyday items were in short supply

questions.q: What problem did the prospector have?
options: There were no trousers in California.
They did not like Levi's product.
questions.explain: couldn't find a pair of trousers strong enough to last = không tìm được quần đủ bền → quần áo nhanh rách (wore out quickly). A sai vì bài không nói California không có quần.
questions.evidence: he couldn't find a pair of trousers strong enough to last

questions.q: Where did the word 'denim' come from?
options: The name of a French fabric.
David Jacobs, the tailor, thought of it.
questions.explain: Vải 'serge de Nimes' từ Pháp, sau này gọi là denim.
questions.evidence: a twilled cotton cloth from France called 'serge de Nimes.' The fabric later became known as denim

questions.q: Which of the following best describes indigo dye?
options: A long-lasting, practical colour that did not show dirt.
A colour used on all kinds of fabric to make it stronger.
A very rare and desirable colour that was difficult to create.
An affordable dark colour that was only used by poor people.
questions.explain: durability = bền màu; darkness of tone + không giặt thường xuyên được → màu tối, không lộ bẩn. B, C, D không có trong bài.
questions.evidence: The durability of indigo as a colour and its darkness of tone made it a good choice when frequent washing was not possible

newWords.meaning: ý định (with the intention of + V-ing)

vocab.meaning: quyết định (v → n)
vocab.example: It was a difficult decision.

vocab.meaning: thành công (v → n → adj → adv)
vocab.colloc: succeed in V-ing · a great success
vocab.example: She worked hard and became successful.

vocab.meaning: đạt được → thành tích
vocab.colloc: achieve a goal · a great achievement
vocab.example: Passing the exam was a big achievement.

vocab.meaning: khác → khác biệt → sự khác biệt
vocab.example: Small changes can make a big difference.

vocab.meaning: năng lượng → tràn đầy năng lượng
vocab.example: I feel more energetic after exercise.

vocab.meaning: sản xuất → sản phẩm → năng suất → một cách năng suất
vocab.example: We need to make our workers more productive.

vocab.meaning: linh hoạt
vocab.example: Ash wood becomes flexible when it is exposed to steam.

vocab.meaning: nghiêm trọng → một cách nghiêm trọng
vocab.example: The disease can have severe effects on the species.

vocab.meaning: sự giàu có → giàu có
vocab.example: The novel is about the pursuit of wealth and love.

vocab.meaning: sự thoải mái → thoải mái → không thoải mái
vocab.example: These shoes are very comfortable.

vocab.meaning: kiên nhẫn → thiếu kiên nhẫn → sự kiên nhẫn
vocab.example: Learning a language needs patience.

vocab.meaning: trung thực → không trung thực → sự trung thực
vocab.example: I'm an honest person and I hate lying.

vocab.meaning: có thể → không thể → khả năng
vocab.example: It is impossible to learn a language in a week.

vocab.meaning: có trách nhiệm → trách nhiệm
vocab.example: Parents have a responsibility to protect their children.

vocab.meaning: -ed: người cảm thấy; -ing: vật gây ra
vocab.colloc: be excited about · an exciting film
vocab.example: The children were excited about the trip.

vocab.meaning: ngạc nhiên (-ed người, -ing vật)
vocab.colloc: be surprised at · a surprising result
vocab.example: The children were surprised when the teacher closed the books.

vocab.meaning: thường xuyên → một cách thường xuyên → tần suất
vocab.example: Practise English as frequently as possible.

vocab.meaning: cẩn thận → bất cẩn → một cách cẩn thận
vocab.example: The car crashed because the driver was careless.

vocab.meaning: thông minh → trí thông minh
vocab.example: He was intelligent enough to understand my gestures.

vocab.meaning: nền kinh tế → thuộc kinh tế → tiết kiệm
vocab.example: Population growth has caused serious social and economic problems.

vocabMcq.q: Small changes like these can make a big ___.
vocabMcq.explain: Sau a big cần danh từ: make a difference.

vocabMcq.q: She speaks English very ___ after living in London for two years.
vocabMcq.explain: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ speaks → trạng từ fluently.

vocabMcq.q: Passing the exam was a great ___ for him.
vocabMcq.explain: Sau a great cần danh từ: achievement.

vocabMcq.q: The film was so ___ that I fell asleep.
vocabMcq.explain: Vật gây ra cảm giác → -ing: boring.

vocabMcq.q: Don't be so ___. We've only been waiting a few minutes.
vocabMcq.explain: Trái nghĩa của patient là impatient (tiền tố im- trước p). Câu này có trong đề trường Test 1.

vocabMcq.q: We need to work more ___ to finish the project on time.
vocabMcq.explain: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ work → trạng từ productively.

vocabMcq.q: He is an ___ man; he never tells lies.
vocabMcq.explain: Trước danh từ man cần tính từ; never tells lies → honest.

vocabMcq.q: It is ___ to learn a foreign language in a week.
vocabMcq.explain: It is + tính từ; nghĩa ngược → impossible (không có unpossible).

vocabMcq.q: I felt very ___ when I forgot her name.
Parents have a ___ to look after their children.
vocabMcq.explain: Sau a cần danh từ: responsibility.

speaking.introTitle: Bài giới thiệu 4–5 câu (điền thông tin của bạn, nói tự nhiên, đừng đọc thuộc lòng)
intro: Good morning. My name is ___ and I'm from ___.
I graduated from ___ University, majoring in ___.
At the moment, I'm working as a/an ___ at ___. I have worked there for ___ years.
I'd like to do a master's degree in ___ because ___.
In my free time, I enjoy ___.
speaking.frame: Ý chính → Lý do (because…) → Ví dụ (For example…). Mỗi câu trả lời 2–4 câu là đủ.
rescue: Sorry, could you repeat the question, please?
That's a good question. Let me think…
I'm not sure, but I think…

questions.q: Why did you choose your major at university?
questions.hint: Quá khứ đơn: I chose… because I was interested in… (không dùng have chosen).

questions.q: What did you find most difficult when you were a student?
questions.hint: The most difficult thing was + V-ing… For example, in my second year, I…

questions.q: Why do you want to study for a master's degree at this university?
questions.hint: I want to… because… Nhắc tên trường, ngành, và 1 lý do công việc.

questions.q: How will a master's degree help your career?
questions.hint: It will help me… / I'm going to… Nói 1 ví dụ cụ thể trong công việc.

questions.q: What would you do if you didn't pass this exam?
questions.hint: Điều kiện loại 2: If I didn't pass, I would… (would + V nguyên mẫu).

rubric: Trôi chảy, tương tác được với giám khảo
Ngữ pháp (thì, câu gián tiếp, điều kiện)
Từ vựng đúng chủ đề học tập
Trả lời đúng câu hỏi, có lý do và ví dụ

reviewQuiz.q: He asked me if I ___ him the day before.
reviewQuiz.explain: "Did you see me yesterday?" → lùi thì saw → had seen; yesterday → the day before.

reviewQuiz.q: Da Nang, ___ my brother works, is a beautiful city.
reviewQuiz.explain: Sau là my brother works, đủ S + V → where.

reviewQuiz.q: She suggested ___ a taxi because it was late.
You'd better ___ your parents where you are going.
Unless you ___ harder, you will fail.
reviewQuiz.explain: Unless + khẳng định, hiện tại đơn.

reviewQuiz.q: He drove ___ and had an accident.
reviewQuiz.explain: Bổ nghĩa cho drove → trạng từ carelessly.

reviewQuiz.q: The teacher told us ___ in the library.
If I ___ more time, I would learn to cook.
Despite ___ tired, she finished the report.
